_comment: Inline style declarations emitted by ssg's syntax highlighter, mapped to the classes fix-ssg-html rewrites them into. The site's CSP is style-src 'self' 'unsafe-hashes' <one hash>, so any inline style attribute other than that one hash is blocked: the code blocks shipped unstyled and logged a CSP violation for each of 23,000 occurrences. Rewriting to classes removes inline styles entirely rather than widening the policy.
_invariant: fix-ssg-html fails the build on an inline style it cannot map, so a new highlighter colour cannot silently ship blocked.
